02 / Projects & research

Work in detail.

Projects across industrial improvement, academic design and independent learning.

From the CVIndustrial training · Thesis · Product designNext: Experience ↗
UNILEVER BANGLADESH · 2026

Daily Production Planning Dashboard

I turned a monthly planning spreadsheet into a selectable daily view of scheduled products, production volume and line loading. I checked its daily totals against the source plan so the summary remained consistent.

ExcelProduction planningDashboard designData validation
UNILEVER BANGLADESH · 2026

Equipment & Sensor Inventory

I organised sensor records by equipment, device type, location and function, creating a clearer reference for troubleshooting, spare planning and future monitoring work.

Sensor mappingAsset recordsInstrumentation
UNILEVER BANGLADESH · 2026

Maintenance Management System & Spare Parts Tracker

I standardised maintenance checklists and linked machines, preventive tasks and spare parts in an Excel tracker. The structured records could provide a starting point for future machine-learning-based predictive maintenance if the company chooses to pursue it.

Machine masterPreventive maintenanceSpare mappingExcel
UNILEVER BANGLADESH · 2026

Packing Defect Investigation

I inspected defective packs, compared observations with quality records and spoke with operators. I grouped possible causes across machine, method, material and people factors and outlined countermeasures for review.

Quality analysisOperator inputFishbone analysis
UNDERGRADUATE THESIS · ONGOING

Digital twin for remaining useful life prediction

Supervised by Dr. Nafis Ahmad · Department of IPE, BUET

Researching an IoT-enabled digital twin of an industrial asset for condition monitoring and remaining useful life estimation. The proposed approach connects sensor readings with a virtual model and uses degradation patterns to inform predictive maintenance.

Ongoing research: this describes the thesis direction, not a completed production deployment.
Condition monitoringDigital twinRUL estimationOngoing research
SIMULATION 02 · DIGITAL TWIN

Predict the breakdown.

A virtual motor degrades over time. Its twin tracks vibration and temperature and estimates remaining useful life (RUL). Maintain it before it fails.
